prospective_start_rule: strictly after policy commit AND actual forecast registration; never reconstruct prior forecasts; daily event predictions only on newly confirmed pivot after registration
benchmark: B1 directional historical median, same event and information time

rules.bootstrap: paired quarterly cluster, 1500 draws, at least 8 nonempty calendar quarters; 90% interval exploratory; prospective familywise correction required across four candidates before promotion
rules.censoring: all open/gap events reported; no scoring as completed; same labels and eligibility across models
rules.evaluation: freeze all candidates; no interim selection; use first 50 eligible complete primary events or more until required cluster count, whichever later; no double-counting forecast revisions or markets
rules.promotion: manual review only; require multiplicity-adjusted paired inference, coverage and width assessment, baseline improvement, documented code version and untouched prospective cohort; no automatic promotion
rules.retraining: historical audit updates are descriptive, not permission to tune candidate settings; new versions need fresh cohort

limits: No model predictions registered by this policy. Prospective event collector and scoring integration still need implementation; first_touch and full path require separate protocol. Historical evaluation repeated; no claim of independent performance.
